description: Session-length-as-data 'never assuming constant' is proven only as rule-derived bounds; the plan's positive witness of TWO differing open-session lengths is structurally not constructible under forex-17NY
expected: exhibit two open sessions of different length both resolving correctly, showing length is not assumed constant
observed: UNPROVEN (not a defect) - every open session is exactly 24h because US DST transitions (Sun 02:00 NY) fall only inside the closed weekend gap [Fri 17:00 NY, Sun 17:00 NY); no non-24h open session exists to observe. The 'as data / not constant' law is instead evidenced by source structure (G3: no session-length constant) and by open/close equalling the independently-computed 17:00-NY rollover instants.
